title: 해양에서 발생한 재난의 긴급구조활동 평가 및 긴급구조교육에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
title_original: 해양에서 발생한 재난의 긴급구조활동 평가 및 긴급구조교육에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 6 (Reporting and Notification of Evaluation Results)
(1) The leader of an evaluation team shall prepare a report on the evaluation results in accordance with the emergency rescue response plan. Where the team leader is the head of a Local Rescue Headquarters under Article 5 of the Act on Search and Rescue, etc. at Sea, the team leader shall report to the head of the Regional Rescue Headquarters under the same Article; where the team leader is the head of a Regional Rescue Headquarters, the team leader shall report to the Commissioner General of the Korea Coast Guard.
(2) Where the team leader finds it necessary as a result of evaluating the emergency rescue activities of an emergency rescue support agency, the team leader may notify the head of that agency of the evaluation results: Provided, That where corrective action is required or there are important matters requiring improvement or supplementation, the team leader shall notify that agency of the evaluation results.
